// Scratch test, not part of any suite: writes what today's propagateKepler returns for the states of
// pf15_kepler_precheck.py --write-inputs, for that script's --compare mode.
// Run: copy to tests/zz-pf15-kepler.test.ts, then
//   KEPLER_CASES=cases.json KEPLER_OUT=outputs.json npx vitest run tests/zz-pf15-kepler.test.ts
// and delete the copy.
// The copy uses Node's fs and process, which the project's typecheck does not know: delete it before a typecheck.
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { it } from 'vitest';
import { propagateKepler } from '../src/physics/orbital';

it('writes the outputs', () => {
  const cases = JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.env.KEPLER_CASES!, 'utf8')) as { r: number[]; v: number[]; dt: number; out?: unknown }[];
  for (const c of cases) {
    const o = propagateKepler({ x: c.r[0], y: c.r[1], z: c.r[2] }, { x: c.v[0], y: c.v[1], z: c.v[2] }, c.dt);
    c.out = { r: [o.r.x, o.r.y, o.r.z], v: [o.v.x, o.v.y, o.v.z] };
  }
  writeFileSync(process.env.KEPLER_OUT!, JSON.stringify(cases));
});
